project.name: AnythingLLM
project.description: An open-source AI application for chatting with documents, building tool-using agents, and configuring model, embedding, and vector database providers across local and hosted deployments.
project.business_goal: Make private, configurable AI assistants and document-grounded agent workflows usable without requiring users to assemble the model, document, and data infrastructure themselves.

objectives.text: Let users ingest documents and ask questions grounded in retrieved document passages.
Let users automate multi-step tasks through tool-using agents, custom tools, MCP integrations, and visual agent flows.
Allow users to select and combine model, embedding, and vector database providers, including local options.
Support persistent memory and scheduled agent work so assistance can continue across interactions and run on a schedule.
Support self-hosted deployments and multi-user workspaces with access controls for private knowledge and AI workflows.
Make user-provided and synchronized knowledge searchable through configurable ingestion, embedding, vector storage, and retrieval workflows.
Extend document chat and agents with audio, speech, image, and meeting workflows while supporting local processing where documented.
Protect workspace data with documented access controls and expose assistant capabilities through APIs and embeddable interfaces.

capabilities.name: Document-grounded chat (RAG)
capabilities.description: Processes user documents into searchable chunks, retrieves relevant passages for a workspace question, and supplies that context to an LLM.

capabilities.name: Tool-using AI agents
capabilities.description: Runs LLM-driven agents that select and invoke tools to complete user tasks, with built-in and extensible tool integrations.

capabilities.name: Composable agent workflows
capabilities.description: Lets users compose, execute, and debug multi-step workflows from configurable blocks, including LLM instructions and API calls.

capabilities.name: MCP tool integrations
capabilities.description: Connects agent workflows to external tools and services through Model Context Protocol integrations.

capabilities.name: Provider abstraction for models and data stores
capabilities.description: Separates the application workflows from specific LLM, embedder, and vector database vendors so deployments can choose compatible providers.

capabilities.name: Dynamic model routing
capabilities.description: Routes conversations to configured models according to user-defined rules and request characteristics.

capabilities.name: Persistent agent memory
capabilities.description: Stores and retrieves selected information across interactions to personalize later assistance.

capabilities.name: Scheduled agent jobs
capabilities.description: Runs prompts or agent-capable tasks repeatedly on a configured schedule.

capabilities.name: Multi-user workspaces and access control
capabilities.description: Organizes knowledge and AI interactions into workspaces and applies user identity, permissions, and access controls.

capabilities.name: Self-hosted and local model deployment
capabilities.description: Supports deployments where application data and selected model infrastructure can run in a user-controlled or local environment.

capabilities.name: Operational telemetry and logging
capabilities.description: Captures application telemetry and operational logs that support diagnosis and product operation; the graph should distinguish existing telemetry from end-to-end agent tracing unless the source code confirms tracing.

capabilities.name: Document ingestion and synchronization
capabilities.description: Accepts documents and watched sources, processes content, and maintains searchable workspace knowledge as supported sources change.

capabilities.name: Embedding, retrieval, and vector storage strategy
capabilities.description: Combines configurable embedding models, vector database adapters, and retrieval behavior to ground chat and agent responses in workspace knowledge.

capabilities.name: Local meeting capture and agentic follow-up
capabilities.description: The desktop Meeting Assistant records or imports meetings, transcribes and indexes them, supports transcript questions, and proposes tool-based follow-up actions. Official docs describe local processing and platform limitations; no matching implementation path is asserted from this server/collector checkout.

capabilities.name: Speech and image generation capabilities
capabilities.description: Provides configurable speech transcription, text-to-speech, and image-generation integrations alongside text-based model workflows.

capabilities.name: Workspace security and data governance
capabilities.description: Applies user and workspace access controls and documents how private data is handled across deployment and AI provider choices.

capabilities.name: API and embeddable assistant surfaces
capabilities.description: Makes assistant and workspace functions available through documented APIs and embeddable chat interfaces.
